trips.route_note: Take a direct train or bus from Hyderabad to Warangal (roughly 2.5-3 hours), then use local autos to reach the fort and temple sites.
see: Warangal Fort ruins and Kakatiya gateways
Ramappa Temple (UNESCO site, short taxi onward)
trips.why: Direct train takes about 2h 28m and local autos connect the fort and temple sites.
know: Warangal Fort and the Thousand Pillar Temple are the classic sights
Start early to fit fort and temples in one day

bus.via: FlixBus Hyderabad - Patancheru to FlixBus Kohinoor Family Dhaba

trips.route_note: Direct trains and buses run from Hyderabad to Bidar in about 3 hours; the fort and monuments are a short auto ride from the station/bus stand.
trips.why: Direct train is faster than the bus and the monuments are a short auto ride from the station.
know: Bidar Fort is the main draw and is closed on certain days, so check before going
Allow time for the auto ride from the station to the fort

trips.route_note: Buses from Hyderabad's MGBS reach Medak in about 2-2.5 hours; the cathedral and fort are close to the bus stand.
trips.why: Frequent buses from MGBS reach Medak in about 2-2.5 hours and the sights are near the bus stand.
know: Medak Cathedral and the fort are close to the bus stand
Go in the cooler morning hours for the cathedral visit
